1. (Currently amended) A control system comprising: a processor; a memory coupled to the processor and storing instructions; and a controller comprising the processor and memory, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to automation components in the control system and to facilitate performance of a process through interoperation with the automation components by generating a holistic state data, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: executing instructions to determine a model configured to describe the process used by the controller; executing instructions to determine input and output variables of the process; executing instructions to determine constraints on the input and output variables; executing instructions to determine an objective function associated with the process used by the controller; and executing instructions to store the model, the input and output variables, the constraints, and the objective function in one of a plurality of fields in the holistic state data to enable the automation components to detect and operate with the controller upon receiving the holistic state data, wherein the holistic state data is generated by the controller and comprises a tangible, non-transitory data structure stored in the memory.

2. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a communication network and to communicate the holistic state data to each of the automation components upon connecting to the communication network, wherein the holistic state data is transmitted as a standardized data packet.

3. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to be communicatively coupled to the automation components via a backplane and to communicate the holistic state data to the automation components upon connecting to the backplane, wherein the backplane comprises a hardware interconnection structure.

4. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the holistic state data is a standardized format understood by each of the automation components, wherein the standardized format comprises predefined field structures and data types.

5. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: executing instructions to determine an intermediate search result of an optimization search; executing instructions to determine a state of the optimization search when the intermediate search result is determined; and executing instructions to store the intermediate search result and the state in an optimization state field of the holistic state data.

6. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data to facilitate performing an optimization search in conjunction with one or more of the automation components in the control system, wherein the optimization search comprises a computational algorithm executed by the controller.

7. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to generate the holistic state data by: executing instructions to determine computational capabilities of the controller; executing instructions to determine interconnections with the automation components in the control system; and executing instructions to store the computational capabilities and the interconnections in a controller settings field of the holistic state data.

8. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller is configured to communicate the holistic state data to a server in the control system via a network connection to facilitate determining an optimization problem, wherein the server comprises a processor and memory configured to receive and process the holistic state data.

9. (Currently amended) The control system of claim 1, wherein the controller comprises an in-memory database configured to store the holistic state data, wherein the in-memory database comprises a data structure maintained in the memory of the controller.

10. (Currently amended) A tangible, non-transitory computer-readable medium configured to store instructions executable by a processor of a controller, wherein the instructions comprise instructions to: receive, using the processor, control system configuration data from a data source; determine, using the processor, automation components communicatively coupled to the controller and characteristics of the automation components based at least in part on the control system configuration data by analyzing the configuration data; determine, using the processor, an optimization problem based at least in part on the automation components and the characteristics of each of the automation components by executing an optimization algorithm; and instruct, using the processor, one or more of the automation components to perform a control action in a process, wherein the control action is determined based at least in part on the optimization problem and comprises a command signal transmitted to the automation components.

11. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a model used by the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on the model used by each of the automation components by integrating the models into the optimization algorithm.

12. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the characteristics of each of the automation components comprise a computing capability of the automation component, wherein the instructions to determine the optimization problem comprise instructions to determine the optimization problem based at least in part on computing capabilities of each of the automation components by evaluating processor and memory resources.

13. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the control system configuration data comprises a plurality of holistic state data, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data corresponds with one of the automation components and comprises a data structure.

14. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein the instructions to determine the automation components and characteristics of the automation components comprise instructions to parse each of the plurality of holistic state data by reading and extracting data from the data structures.

15. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 13, wherein each of the plurality of holistic state data comprises a standardized format with same fields, wherein the standardized format is defined by a schema.

16. (Currently amended) The computer-readable medium of claim 10, wherein the instructions to receive the configuration data comprise instructions to receive the configuration data from a cloud computing system via a network connection.

17. (Currently amended) A method for performing diagnostics on a control system comprising: determining, using a processor, holistic state data captured by a controller in the control system, wherein the holistic state data comprises a data structure stored in a memory; simulating, using the processor, operation of the controller based at least in part on the holistic state data while the controller performs other operations, wherein the simulating comprises executing a simulation algorithm; analyzing, using the processor, the simulation of the controller to perform diagnostics on the controller by comparing simulated results with expected results; and adjusting, using the processor, operation of the control system based at least in part on the diagnostics by modifying controller parameters or automation component settings.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein: simulating operation comprises simulating performance of various control actions by the controller by executing the simulation algorithm with different input parameters; and analyzing the simulation comprises analyzing results of the various control actions by comparing the simulated results with actual system responses.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein analyzing the simulation comprises: determining a predicted response to a control action determined by the controller using a model by executing the model with the control action as input; and comparing the predicted result with an actual response to the control action to determine accuracy of the model by calculating a difference metric.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 19, comprising adjusting the model when the predicted response and the actual response vary by a threshold amount by modifying model parameters based on the difference metric.
